publications.title: Optimizing Energy Efficiency in Smart Street Lighting Systems with LoRa WAN Technology
publications.description: Developed and published a research paper on a LoRaWAN-based Smart Street Lighting System designed for smart city infrastructure. The system enables long-range real-time monitoring, adaptive lighting control, and intelligent object detection using PIR and microwave motion sensors. By dynamically reducing light intensity during inactivity and restoring full brightness upon detection, the solution achieved up to 70% energy savings while improving urban safety and communication efficiency.

Conducted a comparative analysis of MLP, Simple CNN, and LeNet-5 architectures for Handwritten Digit Recognition using the MNIST dataset. Applied K-Fold cross-validation and data preprocessing techniques to improve model robustness and reduce overfitting. The study evaluated model accuracy, validation performance, and training efficiency, where the Simple CNN achieved the highest test accuracy of 99.15%, while LeNet-5 demonstrated an optimal balance between computational efficiency and predictive performance.
publications.title: Comparative Analysis of Handwritten Digit Recognition using MLP, CNN, LeNet-5 Models
